why: The full name 'Sherlock Holmes' is used in ¶7.
¶7 says Watson sat in the corner of a first-class carriage.
¶7 says they had left Reading far behind.
¶7 says the carriage was flying along en route for Exeter.
¶7 describes Holmes's face framed in his ear-flapped travelling-cap.
¶7 says Holmes offered Watson his cigar-case.
They caught a train at Paddington (¶6) that is en route for Exeter (¶7).
